titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
When I was a child, I lived in a small village with my grandparents. Life was simple but happy. We did not have many toys, but we played in the fields and climbed trees all day long. My grandmother told us wonderful stories every evening before we went to sleep. My grandfather taught me how to ride a horse and how to take care of the animals. We did not have a television, so we spent our time outside in nature. Those were the best days of my life. Now I live in a big city, but I still miss my village and my childhood.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Where did the writer live when he was a child?   (1,5 marks)
2) What did the children do all day?   (1,5 marks)
3) What did the grandfather teach him?   (1,5 marks)
4) How does the writer feel about his childhood now?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: We (play) ______ in the fields and (climb) ______ trees.   (2 marks)
2) Rewrite using "used to": Every evening, my grandmother told us stories → My grandmother ______ tell us stories.   (2 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "simple" = ______.   (1 mark)
4) Find in the text a verb that means "remember with sadness" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
Write about your childhood or a happy memory from the past (about 10-12 lines). Say where you were, what you did and how you felt. Use the past simple and "used to".
